subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should `artifacts.download` return session-bound managed-image bytes to an `operator.read` caller after the managed URL, requested session, stored record, transcript reference, message sequence, and content index all match?
rationale: The existing artifact family supports a read-style contract, but exposing host-local bytes is a permanent authorization decision that automated review cannot safely choose.

options.title: Keep operator.read
options.body: Extend the existing transcript-artifact read contract to managed images after every record and coordinate binding passes.

options.title: Require operator.admin
options.body: Keep managed-image bytes admin-only and align the RPC handler, protocol wording, UI recovery, and tests to the stricter scope.

recommendation.title: Keep operator.read
recommendation.body: Extend the existing transcript-artifact read contract to managed images after every record and coordinate binding passes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent artifact and managed-image history plus the explicit request in the PR discussion make this person the strongest available authorization owner.
